thread:
maya: Morning — VertexHealth SI flagged a driver mismatch on the customer's on-prem nodes during marketplace image install last night. Kickoff with the customer at 11:00 PT. Need eng-runtime, eng-infra, and partnerships on the call. Quick triage here so we can go into the call with an action plan.

sam: I can join. Can we confirm which image & driver? SI said registry.redwood/marketplace:redwood-marketplace:v1.12 and reported nvidia driver 525 vs 530 mismatch. Also saw older PCIe firmware on a subset of nodes. @diego can you pick this up and start an escalation? :eyes: 

diego: On it. Created escalation EH-4281 and started a preliminary triage. Assigning to eng-runtime + infra. I'll prepare a rollback and a temporary mitigation for the call.

eng-runtime-bot: Escalation EH-4281 created and assigned to diego, sam. Priority: high. Linked docs: https://confluence.redwood/si/eh-4281

elaine: Quick question — does the marketplace image have a CPU-only fallback we can route the customer to while we fix GPU paths? Want to avoid a full rebuild if possible.

maya: Product ops confirmed tags: v1.12, v1.12-cpu, v1.11-legacy. Proposed immediate plan for call: 1) attempt v1.12-cpu to get customer functional, 2) if GPU is required, provision a validated dedicated pool or coordinate driver/firmware updates. We'll surface tradeoffs in the call.

diego: Quick pre-call checklist I'm going to run:
```
- kube: kubectl describe node <node> -> confirm kernel + nvidia-driver version
- docker: docker pull registry.redwood/marketplace:redwood-marketplace:v1.12
- network: ensure outbound to registry and S3 (443, 10250, 50051)
- logs: check /var/log/redwood/installer.log and dmesg for driver errors
```

sam: Infra items: confirm firewall rules to registry, verify image signature verification path, and what happens if signature fails. If signature fails we need a signed fallback or a manual allow path with audit.

maya: Also need customer-facing talking points ready for the call: what happened, immediate mitigation (cpu image or node pool), estimated timeline for driver fix, next steps. I'll draft and share.

vertex-si: Thanks — we've reproduced the install fail in staging. CPU image works but customer needs GPU for inference throughput. Looking for ETA on driver-compatible image or approved node firmware list.

diego: ETA: I'll validate the compat matrix with ops by EOD; expect 24–48h coordination to push driver + firmware updates. Fast path: provision a dedicated pool with validated drivers (requires support sign-off).

elaine: For the call, please have someone with Marketplace signing privileges available in case we need to approve a temporary signed image or exception. @sam can you prepare a one-click playbook for manual allow?

sam: Yep — I'll prepare a minimal playbook and link the runbook here before 11:00 PT. Will include steps, required approvals, and audit notes.

maya: Great. If the call ends with a go/no-go, we'll turn items into an action board and assign owners. I'll send the invite to eng-runtime, eng-infra, partnerships, product ops now.

ops-oncall: Pager: created incident INC-985 and linked it to EH-4281. Notifying oncall rotation.

maya: Awesome :thumbsup: Sharing the call link + notes in 5.
